links.outcome: LLM medical calculation accuracy under step-by-step evaluation versus final-answer-only evaluation
links.effect: GPT-4o accuracy drops from 62.7% to 43.6% under granular step-by-step evaluation, revealing errors masked by prior evaluations.
links.quote: Under this granular framework, the accuracy of GPT-4o drops from 62.7% to 43.6%, revealing errors masked by prior evaluations.

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLMs with and without retrieval-augmented generation plus code execution pipeline (MedRaC)
links.effect: MedRaC, combining retrieval-augmented generation and Python code execution without fine-tuning, improves accuracy of different LLMs from 16.35% up to 53.19%.
links.quote: Without any fine-tuning, MedRaC improves the accuracy of different LLMs from 16.35% up to 53.19%.

unlisted_practices: Step-by-step evaluation of formula selection, entity extraction and arithmetic separately for medical calculators
Automatic structured error attribution framework for LLM failures
Python code execution tool for LLM arithmetic in clinical calculations

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM safety/accuracy on medical calculations and tests an agentic retrieval-augmented and code execution pipeline (MedRaC) as a safeguard/grounding mechanism to prevent calculation errors across multiple base LLMs.
